gameDescriptionHtml:
Red Wings: Aces of the Sky is an arcade action game that will put you behind the controls of WW1 warplanes. The game combines the action-packed dynamics of classic flight games with modern arcade gameplay and detailed, stylized 3D art. Accompany the legendary Red Baron and conquer the skies of the Great War. Use your unique skills to take your opponents down, develop your deadly pilot aim and become the true ace of the sky!

Full version of the game available in the Upgrade Pack will let you:

  • Play 50 story-driven campaign missions and relive the epic aerial combat of World War I
  • Control 12 historical warplanes of the Entente Powers and the Triple Alliance
  • Upgrade your pilot progression skill tree to improve your stats and skills
  • Fly through different game modes with a friend in local co-op
